Subject: Re: Deployment mode needs - HIPAA/BAA & SOC2 evidence

Hi Rachel / Mark — great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Summary of call: Elara is evaluating deployment options to support PHI workloads. Primary requirements we heard: HIPAA compliance with a signed BAA, SOC2 Type II evidence for our controls, encrypted data at rest (KMS/HSM options), and 12+ months of audit-log retention.

- Deployment options we discussed: 
  * Hosted API: fastest to get started but not suitable for PHI unless we layer dedicated tenancy and BAA — generally not recommended for regulated PHI workflows.
  * Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools (single-tenant) with isolation and SLA — can be used as a near-term approach while we provision Private VPC.
  * Private (VPC / on-prem): recommended for long-term PHI use; supports VPC peering, customer-managed keys, and can be deployed on-prem if required. Estimated lead time: ~6–8 weeks for Private VPC; on-prem longer depending on site readiness.

- What we can provide immediately: redacted SOC2 Type II report, standard BAA draft for review, and answers to the security questionnaire.

Action items / suggested next steps: 
1) Can you confirm whether Elara prefers to: (A) move to Dedicated as an interim and sign BAA now, or (B) commit to Private VPC and start onboarding?
2) Please share the security questionnaire you mentioned; we will provide answers and the redacted SOC2 report by EOD tomorrow.
3) If you want Dedicated short-term, we can scope capacity and provide costs in 24–48 hours.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (redacted copy stub), BAA_draft.docx (stub).

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up with Marissa (contracts) and Rishi (infra) to go over specifics.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — useful recap. A few clarifying questions from our security team: 

1) We need the SOC2 Type II report (redacted acceptable) and confirmation of the report date and coverage (systems in scope).
2) Please provide specifics around key management: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in the Private deployment? For Dedicated, what are the encryption controls and who holds the keys?
3) Audit logs: retention, format, and how we can export logs for our SIEM.
4) BAA: we generally require a signed BAA before moving PHI into any environment. Please share your standard BAA; we will have legal review.
5) Timeline: if we decide to go Private VPC, what's the estimated onboarding time and what dependencies do you need from Elara (network, IP allowlist, certs)?

I've attached Elara_Sec_Questionnaire_v2.pdf — can you fill this out and return? Also cc'ing our internal security POC Mark.

If possible, we'd like SOC2 and a redlined BAA draft by end of week so we can start our internal compliance review.

Thanks,
Rachel
Head of Security Operations
Elara Health

Thanks Dylan — responding with what we can provide and next steps.

- SOC2: attaching a redacted SOC2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_Redacted_2026.pdf) — this covers our inference runtime, control environment, and change management processes (report period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). We can also provide an SOC2 bridge letter if they need more recent coverage.

- BAA: attached a standard BAA draft (BAA_Elara_Draft_20270511.docx). Legal is OK with our standard terms; we can accept minor redlines. For deadlines, we typically turn around counters in 2–3 business days.

- Private VPC timeline: Rishi confirms (below) typical lead time of 6–8 weeks assuming timely network info and approvals. Required items from customer: VPC CIDR, peering/VPN endpoints, list of IPs to allow, approved subnets, and an account contact for certs. We will provide a checklist.

- Dedicated as interim: Operationally, Dedicated reserved capacity can be provisioned in ~3–5 business days once the SOW/commitment is signed; encryption at rest is supported using provider KMS by default. For customer-managed keys we support an option in Private deployments and selected Dedicated configurations (needs legal/infra sign-off).

2) Ask Elara to complete the security questionnaire; we'll fill and return with attachments.
